children: BCB Bancorp launched an underwritten common stock offering and expects a Q3 2026 net loss of $126.2M to $136.1M.
Launched underwritten offering of common stock with a 30-day option for underwriters to buy additional shares.
Marketing approximately $210M of problem loans for sale; non-binding interest received from multiple purchasers.
Expect to transfer ~$96M of CRE and cannabis-related loans to held-for-sale in Q3 2026 as marketing continues.
Anticipated Q3 provision for credit losses of $112M–$120M, including ~$87M pre-tax loss tied to loan sales/transfers.
Recorded ~$50M valuation allowance against net deferred tax assets; expects Q3 net loss of $126.2M–$136.1M.
